g.text: A smaller quantum core is useful, but a dense Fock table is insufficient
Solid: pure core after uniform-loss decomposition. Dashed: unattenuated pure input, not the measured mixed output.
TV budget 0.1 uses tail <= 0.01. Analytic resource calculation only; D is neither MPS bond dimension nor a sampling lower bound.
